The primary tool used for writing is a pen or pencil, though in modern contexts, a keyboard or computer is also commonly used.

To enhance your writing skills, consider the following performance improvement strategies:

1. Establish a consistent writing routine by setting aside dedicated time each day to practice.
2. Participate in writing workshops or courses to gain constructive feedback on your work.
3. Join writing groups to maintain accountability and receive peer support.
4. Read extensively across various genres and styles to broaden your understanding of narrative techniques and literary devices.
